mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.project_id,a.attempt_id,a.source_version,a.parse_version,a.config_revision,a.status, a.failure_manifest,a.request_manifest,a.run_id,a.created_by,a.classification,a.revision,a.lease_owner, a.lease_generation,a.lease_expires_at,a.execution_deadline,a.command_ref,a.result_ref,a.write_intent, s.source_id,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,sv.rights_revision,sv.original_sha256,sv.object_key, sv.object_version,sv.media_type,sv.size_bytes,p.parse_status,g.lifecycle FROM processing_attempt a JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=a.source_version JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.source_version=a.source_version AND p.parse_version=a.parse_version JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.source_version=p.source_version AND g.parse_version=p.parse_version WHERE a.attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND a.created_by=#{userId} AND a.job_type='PARSE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE processing_attempt SET status='RUNNING',lease_owner=#{workerId},lease_generation=lease_generation+1, lease_expires_at=#{leaseUntil},execution_deadline=COALESCE(execution_deadline,#{deadline}), revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND lease_generation=#{generation} AND lease_generation<2 AND (execution_deadline IS NULL OR execution_deadline>#{now}) AND ((status='QUEUED' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at<=#{now}))

UPDATE parse_version SET parse_status='PROCESSING' WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND parse_status IN ('QUEUED','PROCESSING') AND artifact_key IS NULL AND content_sha256 IS NULL

UPDATE parse_version SET processor_manifest=#{processorManifest},content_sha256=#{bundleSha256}, artifact_key=#{artifactKey},artifact_version=#{artifactVersion},artifact_size_bytes=#{artifactSizeBytes}, parse_status=#{parseStatus},failure_manifest=#{failureManifest} WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND parse_status='PROCESSING' AND content_sha256 IS NULL AND artifact_key IS NULL

UPDATE processing_attempt SET status='FAILED',failure_manifest=#{failureManifest},lease_owner=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL,revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE
attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND lease_generation=#{generation} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=#{now}) AND (lease_generation>=2 OR execution_deadline<=#{now})
UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_node WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion}

SELECT p.parse_status AS parseStatus,p.content_sha256 AS contentSha256,p.artifact_key AS artifactKey, p.artifact_version AS artifactVersion,p.artifact_size_bytes AS artifactSizeBytes, p.processor_manifest AS processorManifest,p.failure_manifest AS failureManifest, v.content_sha256 AS registeredSha256 FROM parse_version p JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.version_id=p.parse_version AND v.entity_kind='PARSE_VERSION' WHERE p.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND p.parse_version=#{parseVersion}

SELECT n.node_id AS nodeId,n.ordinal AS ordinal,n.node_kind AS nodeKind,n.locator AS locator,n.content_ref AS contentRef, n.node_hash AS nodeHash,c.chunk_id AS chunkId,c.raw_text AS rawText,c.search_text AS searchText,c.quote_hash AS quoteHash, c.locator AS chunkLocator,c.ordinal AS chunkOrdinal FROM content_node n JOIN source_chunk c ON c.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND c.source_version=n.source_version AND c.parse_version=n.parse_version AND c.node_id=n.node_id WHERE n.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND n.parse_version=#{parseVersion} ORDER BY n.ordinal,n.node_id LIMIT #{fetchLimit}
